verdict.rationale: Bento is an AI-agent observability and improvement platform with its own AI-driven features, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair capability to ask about, but the evidence pack never documents Bento acting as an MCP client. The only MCP mention describes external coding agents loading Bento's docs over MCP. That is the server or docs-delivery direction, not Bento plugging in MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
